title: Eleanor Joins You
description: Meet Eleanor and explore the east part of town together

story: You see Eleanor. Listen to what she has to say.
hints: Use 'cat Eleanor' to see what she has to say.

story: Eleanor: "Oh, it's you! Have you seen my Mum and Dad?"
1: "I'm afraid not. When did you last see them?"
2: "Weren't they with you in the hidden-shelter?"
3: "(lie) Yes, I saw them in town."
Use the 'echo' command to talk to Eleanor.
Eleanor: "Not long ago. The dog ran out again, so they went outside to look for him."
"Let's go to town together and find them. I'm sure I'll be safe if I'm with you."
Eleanor joined you as a companion! You can check how she is any time with 'cat Eleanor'.
Leave the .hidden-shelter. Don't worry, Eleanor will follow!
Eleanor: "Let's go to the east of town."
"Haven't you noticed it before? It's over there! Look over there."
Use 'ls' to see what Eleanor is trying to show you.
hints: Eleanor: Have you forgotten how to look around? You need to use 'ls'.

story: You look in the direction Eleanor is pointing.
There is a narrow road leading to another part of town.
This must take us to the east part.
Eleanor: "Let's go there and see if we can find my parents."
Go into the east of town.
hints: Use 'cd east' to go to the east part of town.
